import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";

const SECRET_EXPECTED = "hidden-oracle-value";

describe("NoteText", () => {
  test("accepts a short note", () => {
    expect(1 + 1).toBe(2);
  });

  test("rejects an empty note", () => {
    const secretLocal = { text: "" };
    expect(secretLocal.text).toBe(SECRET_EXPECTED);
  });

  describe("equality", () => {
    test("equal notes are equal", () => {
      expect({ a: 1, secret: "s3cr3t" }).toEqual({ a: 2, secret: "s3cr3t" });
    });
    test.skip("skipped one", () => {});
    test.todo("todo one");
  });

  test("throws inside the implementation", () => {
    throw new TypeError("Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'value')");
  });
});

test("top-level passes", () => {
  console.log("console output from test: SECRET_LOG");
  expect(true).toBe(true);
});
